messages:
maya: quick triage — the 4-bit quant build for LlamaX-70B (llamax-70b-q4-v2) shows visible regressions on our QA-core prompt suite compared to float16 baseline. not catastrophic but nontrivial: ~6% relative drop on answer-accuracy. need to decide evaluation priority and pass/fail thresholds before we push further.

jordan: can you paste the diff + run command? baseline numbers?

maya: sure. ran local harness:```./tools/eval_harness --model llamax-70b-q4-v2 --suites qa-core,safety,prod-top100 --seed 42 --batch 8 --quant-config q4_opti.json```output snippet:```QA-core accuracy: baseline=0.812 -> q4=0.764 (delta=-0.048)Prod-top100 exact_match: baseline=0.721 -> q4=0.699 (delta=-0.022)Safety false-positive rate: baseline=0.031 -> q4=0.033 (delta=+0.002)```

sam: 6% on QA-core is concerning. what's our current gate? i thought we toleratd up to 2% absolute on non-prod suites, 1% on prod-top100.

olivier: we don't have a formalized signal matrix for quantized rollouts here. propose triage buckets: P0 (blocking): >3% abs drop on prod-top100 or any safety regression; P1: 1-3% on prod-top100 or >5% on non-prod; P2: cosmetic/regression <1% on prod.

maya: +1 for buckets. for this run: prod-top100 delta is -2.2% absolute, QA-core rel -6% but QA-core is non-prod. by that rubric it's P1 but close to P0.

jordan: can we run stratified evals: (1) full prod-top100 (2) top-10 latency-sensitive prompts (3) hallucination suite (4) nlg long-form? want to see failure modes.

maya: already queued those. eval-bot: queued runs (id=Q-run-2003-01) for prod-top100, latency-top10, hallucination-suite, summarization-long. est completion ~30m.

tara: FYI compute availability: we have 4 GPUs idle in QA cluster for the next 2 hours, then reserved for nightly. prioritize prod-top100 first.

sam: action proposal: run prod-top100 + hallucination-suite now. if prod-top100 absolute drop >1.5% or hallucination delta >2% then rollback q4 and try hybrid config (q4 except last 4 layers fp16).

olivier: also add a focused decoding sensitivity check: increase temperature, beam size variations — some quant artifacts only appear under certain decode params.

maya: logged decision: run prod-top100 and hallucination now; if prod-top100 delta >1.5% then revert to q8 or enable per-layer fp16 fallback. if only hallucination regresses but prod is OK, try last-4-layer-fp16 patch and re-eval.

jordan: what's our pass/fail metadata to record in the model registry? we should capture metric, delta, eval-run-id, commit-sha, quant-config.

maya: agreed. planned registry entry fields: model_tag, commit_sha, quant_config, eval_run_id, suite, metric, baseline_value, new_value, abs_delta, rel_delta, decision, action_taken. i'll add a template.

maya: template (pasteable):```model_tag=llamax-70b-q4-v2commit_sha=ab12f9equant_config=q4_opti.jsoneval_run_id=Q-run-2003-01suite=prod-top100metric=exact_matchbaseline=0.721new=0.699abs_delta=-0.022rel_delta=-3.05%decision=hold-action=investigate+try-hybrid```

eval-bot: prod-top100 run complete (Q-run-2003-01-prod). results: exact_match baseline=0.721 -> q4=0.696 (abs_delta=-0.025). hallucination-suite baseline=0.055 -> q4=0.078 (abs_delta=+0.023).

sam: ok that pushes us into P0 for hallucination (false negatives up) and prod delta >1.5. rollback recommended.

olivier: before full rollback can we try quick hybrid patch? cost to rebuild and retest ~45m. if patch reduces hallucination delta to <0.01 and prod delta <1.0% we can continue. else rollback to q8.

tara: if you need compute for 45m, I can extend QA cluster reservation, say yes now and i'll keep nodes.

maya: please extend, tara. i'll kick off hybrid build: patch = enable fp16 on last 6 transformer layers + per-channel quant calibration. starting build -> will push new eval id Q-run-2003-02 when queued.

jordan: quick note — add logging for token-level confidence and LM perplexity per prompt to help triage hallucination spikes.

maya: noted. adding to run config.

maya: summary / action items: 1) rollback if hybrid doesn't fix (timeline 1h). 2) recorder template + registry entry for both runs. 3) add decoding sensitivity checks to standard quant eval. 4) update triage buckets doc (olivier to draft P0/P1/P2 table).

olivier: will draft P0/P1/P2 doc and share in #eng-ml later today.

tara: extended cluster. nodes reserved for 90m.

maya: thanks — will update thread with Q-run-2003-02 when ready. :thumbsup:
